title: Floor cards show a vacant/occupied room summary
description: Floor list rows currently show just the floor label. Wardens want an at-a-glance vacant/occupied summary on each floor card so they don't have to open every floor to see where space is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Each floor card shows counts like 'X vacant / Y occupied' (beds or rooms, consistent with how VacantViewScreen counts)
Counts update live when a checkout/onboarding changes a bed's status, without needing to leave and reopen the floor list

history.note: Added from the v2 feedback session (warden interviews after the v1 field test) and from buried enhancement/limitation notes surfaced while re-reading the full v1 board history.
Starting - feeding BedDao.observeOccupancyByHostel (added in LODGY-53) into the floor list so each card carries live vacant/occupied bed counts.

Floor cards now show 'N vacant / M occupied'. FloorListViewModel combines the floors flow with BedDao.observeOccupancyByHostel (the LEFT-JOIN version, so a floor with no rooms or no beds yet still reports 0/0 instead of disappearing from the summary), producing a FloorListItem per row. Because both sides are Room Flows, a checkout or onboarding that flips a bed re-emits and the card updates in place - no leaving and reopening the screen. Counts are bed-level to match how VacantViewScreen counts, so the two screens are not silently measuring different things. FloorListViewModelTest covers per-floor counts and the empty-floor case. testDebugUnitTest green.
